problem: The existing TABLE-control observer skipped valid null and 64-bit code-5 lexemes before reader identity registration. The established identity selector consequently reported null and wide candidates as Unobserved and did not detect duplicate wide TABLE controls.
change: Register valid code-5 lexemes with the reader before applying the separate 32-bit control-model constraint. Null remains non-identifying, and null or out-of-range values make the table-control model ambiguous and unavailable for source qualification. Invalid lexemes retain tolerant unobserved behavior.

validation.tests: PASS: six identity, class, structural, plotstyle and XRECORD selectors, including 16 existing null/absent/invalid/wide cases and eight wide-duplicate/refusal/corrected-same-reader cases and four repeated-null cases across AC1018/AC1032 and ASCII/binary.
validation.baseline: The previous adapter and library reproduced the pre-existing TABLE header admission failure on AC1018 ASCII handle 0.
validation.gcc16FullTarget: A separate GCC 16 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror syntax check of the entire table-content test translation unit still fails on many pre-existing misleading-indentation diagnostics in that unit and its included controls; the newly added lines were corrected. Log SHA-256 0d0a670f38f2c0bf059b08a7c1f0986db0e632db215cb08baf912339f46041a0. No warnings were disabled.

limits: This change does not grant ownership, output eligibility or format support to unmodeled wide or null TABLE control handles.
